name: designer
description: Main CAD agent. Designs and edits parts using the local mirror and Onshape.

name: planner
description: Turns a design request into a step-by-step plan. Produces a plan only; changes nothing.

name: sim
description: Placeholder for simulation work (milestone 4). Simulation is not available yet.

name: verifier
description: Skeptical read-only checker. Tries to prove a change wrong and reports pass/fail per requirement.
